arguments.name: field
arguments.description: One of tenant, actor, allowTenantOverride or allowedExtensions.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: A lowercased tenant must be 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens and start and end with a letter or digit. Supply nonblank text for actor. For allowTenantOverride use true, false, 1 or 0. For allowedExtensions use comma-separated keys without spaces, or an empty string to clear.
